goals.currentTitleEn: Use representations of quadratic functions appropriately
goals.currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann allgemeine Form, Scheitelpunktform und Nullstellenform quadratischer Funktionen unterscheiden, ihre jeweiligen Vorteile erklären und in passenden Situationen gezielt verwenden.
goals.currentDescriptionEn: The learner can distinguish the standard, vertex, and factorized forms of quadratic functions, explain their respective advantages, and use them purposefully in suitable situations.

goals.currentDescriptionEn: For exponential growth and decay models, the learner can determine the doubling time or half-life and interpret the calculated factor time in context.

goals.currentTitleEn: Interpret the asymptotic behaviour of exponential functions
goals.currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann das Verhalten einer exponentiellen Funktion für große positive oder negative Argumente aus ihrem Term und Graphen beschreiben, eine waagerechte Asymptote angeben und ihre Bedeutung im Kontext deuten.
goals.currentDescriptionEn: The learner can describe the behaviour of an exponential function for large positive or negative inputs from its expression and graph, identify a horizontal asymptote, and interpret its meaning in context.

goals.currentDescriptionEn: The learner can determine average rates of change as difference quotients, interpret them as secant slopes, and use them to motivate the transition to instantaneous rates of change as tangent slopes.
